judge_note: Neutral referee, round 2. Cross-checked each answer against the finishing spec, KB1/KB2/KB3 (verified FINISHING_EFFICACY_FORMULA human_review_required=false + recompute-derived-scores + failure_modes; SHRINKAGE_GATE human_review_required=false + '+/-3-5% confirm per buyer' + tumble-dry flag; FASTNESS_DELTAE_COMPOSITION duty-exposure framing + dye-node-outsourced), the router honesty gate (N1-N7) and dominance rules, and the DECISION_MEMO gate set (G1-G4). The answerer was disciplined and self-critical: it did not over-claim support, tagged honestly, held every governing blocker + the per-piece finishing job-work rate [UNKNOWN], kept off-paper as mechanism, and used cotton duty ~16.5% (never ~7%). Six answers land partial by the answerer's own read; the judge confirms those partials are real spec limitations, not fabrication. Three of the partials expose latent OVERCLAIM/UNTAGGED defects in the KB node CONTRACTS themselves (efficacy-node cardinal-read backstop, shrinkage-threshold status tag, cost-band inline derivation) that are high-confidence mechanical fixes and still pass build; the rest need new procedure/content and are 'propose'. No high-severity finding: nothing threatens the honesty floor, the duty trio, the pilling gate correctness, or the dominance boundaries; the defects are contract-hardening, not errors of substance. dry=false because there are material MED findings.

findings_summary.note: type/disposition/severity counts tally answers, not unique findings; the four 'none' dispositions are the four 'ok' answers (Q05/Q08/Q10 clean support + Q11 correct-deference watch-adjacent).

findings.evidence: finishing.specialist.json purpose fixes A1 as 'cotton-blend A1'; capabilities[1] 'pick the fibre-route-specific anti-pill route' + KB2 A1_COTTON_RECIPE + KB1 ANTIPILL_ROUTE_MAP write the A1 route on the PURE-cotton archetype (gas-singe yarn + cellulase garment). No node states a blend-fraction threshold at which gas-singe is disqualified by thermoplastic beading, or how much of the pure-cotton grade cellulase buys at a given cellulosic share. The answer correctly grounds the DIRECTION (singe fails on the thermoplastic fraction, cellulase touches only cellulosics, acrylic-fraction pilling is a yarn-PO lever) as [FACT] and holds the numeric thresholds [UNKNOWN] pending PPS.
findings.fix: Add a per-article blend caveat to A1_COTTON_RECIPE / ANTIPILL_ROUTE_MAP: state the A1 blend ratio explicitly, note that gas-singe applicability degrades and cellulase yield falls with rising acrylic fraction (thresholds [UNKNOWN] until PPS), and route the acrylic-fraction pilling to the yarn PO. This needs new content + a PPS measurement to set the thresholds; do NOT fabricate a cutoff percentage.
findings.reason: real content gap requiring measurement/judgment (PPS swatch on the actual A1 blend); the honesty binding forbids inventing a threshold to close it, so it is a backlog item, not an apply_now.

findings.evidence: KB1 ANTIPILL_ROUTE_MAP CON concedes 'a rigid four-route map can hide that several routes stack on one cotton garment' (A1 = gas-singe AND cellulase). KB3 TWO_PO_RECIPE / KB2 TWO_PO_STRUCTURE close only the SKIPPED-step seam ('a step skipped at one vendor passes the test at the other'). No node composes RETAINED_STRENGTH_CAP (check 4, cellulase over/under-processing signal) + a yarn-lot singe/hairiness read into a per-route ATTRIBUTION rule for a stacked pilling fail. The answer correctly refuses the reflex 'blame the spinner' and proposes coding a mixed fail back on BOTH POs pending an isolating swatch re-test.
findings.genuinely_supported: skipped-step seam yes; stacked-route fault attribution no
findings.fix: Add a per-route diagnostic procedure to the two-PO recipe / ACCEPTANCE_GATE_EIGHT_CHECKS: on a stacked A1 pilling fail with both routes nominally applied, isolate with a singed-yarn-only swatch and a bio-polished-garment swatch re-test and code back on both POs until isolated; use the in-spec A1 strength reading as the cellulase over/under-dose signal. New procedure, not a number.
findings.reason: genuine missing fault-isolation procedure requiring design judgment; not a mechanical one-line correction.

findings.verdict: specialist_supports=partial CONFIRMED; latent OVERCLAIM in the node contract
findings.evidence: kb3_quality_acceptance.kb.json FINISHING_EFFICACY_FORMULA: acceptance_test says 'derived scores recompute from its base metrics' and 'human_review_required': false (verified at node id FINISHING_EFFICACY_FORMULA, human_review_required=false). Its failure_modes DO name 'treating the efficacy magnitudes as measured rather than directional' and 'using a high A1 efficacy to justify finishing a cheap yarn elsewhere', and escalation_triggers[4] defers uplift-as-magnitude, and PILLING_GATE_POSTWASH holds per-construction uplift [UNKNOWN]. But the node forces no OUTPUT label to ordinal/directional and removes the human backstop, so a downstream reader can plug 'half a grade' and read a cardinal A1>A2>A3 spend ranking. The answer identifies this precisely as latent-in-the-node, not in the answer.
findings.genuinely_supported: the ordinal/directional read is fully supported; a cardinal decision-grade read is an overclaim the node under-guards
findings.fix: MECHANICAL: on FINISHING_EFFICACY_FORMULA set human_review_required=true and add one output-contract line: 'output is ORDINAL/directional (which route earns its place per article), NOT a cardinal decision-grade score; per-route ICI-uplift magnitudes [UNKNOWN] pending PPS; do not feed as a spend-sizing number to T4.' Consistent with escalation_triggers[4] and router N1/N6; no substance change, passes build.
findings.reason: high-confidence, in-scope, mechanical hardening of an existing self-named failure mode (add a tag/backstop, soften an implied over-claim); does not require new research and preserves all substance.

findings.evidence: kb3 COST_OF_QUALITY_TRADE carries the per-article bands (~$0.30-0.90 A1 / ~$0.25-0.70 A2 / ~$0.60-1.80 A3) tagged '[ESTIMATE: triangulated]' with 'ordering HIGH, absolutes LOW', and JOBWORK_RATE_BLOCKER names the per-piece finishing rate [UNKNOWN] with a 'do-not-feed-as-points' instruction. So the honesty guard EXISTS in substance. What is missing is a single INLINE method+basis+confidence string at the point of the number, and an explicit statement of WHY the A3>A1>A2 ordering is [ESTIMATE]-grade independent of the [UNKNOWN] rate (it rests on wet-step count/skill/irreversibility per route, not on the missing rate). The answer states this correctly.
findings.genuinely_supported: yes in substance; the inline derivation label is incomplete
findings.fix: MECHANICAL: append to COST_OF_QUALITY_TRADE an inline string: 'method=triangulated by route step-content; basis=A3 milling+boarding > A1 +cellulase bath > A2 chemical top-up; confidence: ordering HIGH, absolutes LOW; per-piece Ludhiana finishing job-work rate [UNKNOWN] - not a T4 point.' Codifies what the node already implies; passes build.
findings.reason: mechanical labelling completion of an already-tagged estimate; low severity because the guard (do-not-feed-as-points) already exists, but the inline string closes the over-trust risk cheaply.

findings.evidence: kb3 FASTNESS_DELTAE_COMPOSITION (verified) ties the composition-vs-care-label check to blend-ratio duty exposure and names the dye node outsourced. The answer flags-and-routes exactly per the router: it states the CORRECTED [FACT] duty trio (cotton ~16.5% NEVER ~7%, wool ~16%, acrylic/MMF ~32%) and the 50% MMF chief-weight cliff as EXPOSURE only, then defers the landed/IOR/duty CONSEQUENCE to unit_economics per dominance rule 'landed cost/duty = unit_economics'. Passes N5 (~16.5% not ~7%), N2/N3 (IOR blend-drift as flag not adjudication), and stays in-lane.
findings.reason: clean support; correctly scoped flag-and-route, corrected duty trio, no ~7% residue, no lane crossing. A verified strength.

findings.evidence: kb2 MILLING_GATE ('single most destructive finishing failure', gated on felt/area-shrink + dimensions + hand 'never to the clock', and 'the real A3 risk is in-cluster wool-finishing skill and capacity ... felt-control is the whole game') + A3_WOOL_RECIPE (route to a specialist wool finisher; own spec+gate) + OUTSOURCE_BOUNDARY; KB3 ACCEPTANCE_GATE_EIGHT_CHECKS check 6 (A3 milling felt-limit mandatory) is POST-HOC; JOBWORK_RATE_BLOCKER carries felt-control reliability [UNKNOWN]. The answer honestly concedes there is NO arms-length in-run control: pre-loss protection reduces to vendor selection + PPS/first-piece dial-in, and the gate only rejects an already-dead felted lot.
findings.genuinely_supported: the control claim is correctly BOUNDED, not over-reached; the residual is an unclosable exposure the spec already admits
findings.fix: Not a contradiction to correct but an exposure to make explicit: add to A3_WOOL_RECIPE / MILLING_GATE an in-run-control caveat that the outsourced irreversible milling step has no real-time brand control, so protection is (a) vendor qualification on proven felt-control craft, (b) PPS/first-piece setpoint dial-in, (c) post-hoc reject; and price the residual over-mill risk into A3 working-capital exposure. Needs judgment on how to word the risk-pricing.
findings.reason: the spec is already honest here (no false 'we gate it in real time' claim), so severity is med and the fix is an explicit exposure statement + A3 WC-risk pricing, which is judgment, not a mechanical one-liner.

findings.evidence: kb3 SHRINKAGE_GATE (verified): scope includes 'the +/-3-5% same-wash tolerance' and 'the tumble-dry tighter-limit risk'; anti_patterns include 'treating +/-3-5% as fixed without buyer confirmation'; acceptance_test requires 'a confirm-per-buyer note'; human_review_required=false. escalation_triggers[5] says the target 'must be confirmed per buyer before it gates a lot'. Yet the node presents +/-3-5% as the accept BAND inside an ACCEPTANCE gate without carrying an explicit [UNKNOWN]-pending-buyer STATUS TAG on the threshold, so for the Turlock tumble-dry household a lot can pass green at +/-4% and still fail the real customer. The answer names this precisely.
findings.genuinely_supported: the risk is flagged in prose; the gating threshold itself is not tagged as provisional
findings.fix: MECHANICAL: tag the SHRINKAGE_GATE threshold '[ESTIMATE: working target; buyer-confirmed value UNKNOWN-pending-buyer]', gate PROVISIONALLY at the tighter end (+/-3%) for a tumble-dry household until the buyer confirms, and require the exact customer wash+dry cycle before it becomes a hard confirmed pass/fail line. Codifies escalation_triggers[5] + the node's own anti_pattern; passes build.
findings.reason: high-confidence mechanical tag-add that the node's own anti_pattern and escalation trigger already demand; converts a silently-provisional gate line into an explicitly-tagged one without new research.

findings.evidence: kb3 SPIRALITY_SISTER_FAULT reads spirality as 'the post-wash exposure of an unbalanced singles-twist yarn-PO dial ... the gate reads it ... but cannot FIX it; the fix is upstream balanced ply in the yarn PO', with a CON conceding 'no garment-side remedy once a bad-twist lot is already knit ... the cost is already sunk'. ACCEPTANCE_GATE_EIGHT_CHECKS check 3 detects it. The answer routes ownership to the yarn PO (yarn_sourcing per dominance), claims NO finishing rescue, codes back to the named supplier, and reinforces the second-line principle. No over-claim; correct detect-at-gate/fix-upstream framing.
findings.fix: none (the sunk-cost-once-knit residual is already stated in the node's own CON)
findings.reason: clean support; a verified strength and the clearest case of the gate exposing a yarn-floor failure the finishing line honestly cannot rescue.

findings.evidence: kb3 HOME_WASH_PROMISE + ACCEPTANCE_GATE_EIGHT_CHECKS check 5 grade hand/softener-durability AFTER the same home wash, and conflicts_and_dominance holds 'the post-wash gate dominates the showroom sample'; boundaries[5] forbids presenting a showroom-fresh hand as the acceptance result. But no node resolves the CONTRACTUAL case where the buyer-APPROVED reference/PPS sample is itself the freshly-softened masked one: a lot matching that reference could pass sign-off while failing the post-wash gate, and the authority to reject it is asserted (dominance rule) but not operationalised against a masked approved reference. The answer states 'caught technically yes; authority asserted but not fully operationalised'.
findings.genuinely_supported: technical catch yes; contractual authority against a masked approved reference not closed
findings.fix: Add a procedural requirement that the approved reference / PPS sample be POST-WASH-graded (approve on the washed hand, not the showroom hand) so the sign-off reference and the acceptance gate share the same post-wash condition and the rejection authority is contractual. This is a real procedure addition touching the sign-off contract (some judgment on wording), best proposed rather than hand-applied.
findings.reason: genuine procedural gap in the sign-off contract; the fix changes the buyer-approval procedure (not a stale figure or a missing tag), so it needs the finalizer's judgment, not a mechanical apply.

findings.reason: clean support and a correct defer-by-design; off-paper kept mechanism-not-accusation, no fabricated magnitude, depth routed to T1. A verified strength on a standing failure-mode axis.
